import ast
import platform
from pathlib import Path
paths = [Path('main.py'), *Path('utils').glob('*.py'), *Path('tests').glob('*.py')]
for path in paths:
    ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), filename=str(path), feature_version=(3, 10))
print(f'Python 3.10 grammar: {len(paths)} files passed. Actual runtime: {platform.python_implementation()} {platform.python_version()} on {platform.system()}.')
